title: Pick a domain registrar
ask: Our domain name is up for renewal and I'd like to move it somewhere better. Three registrars are in sources/options.md. Please write a brief with one pick.
background: We have a single .example-style business domain and no plans for more.
Last year the renewal price was nearly triple the first year price, and I only found out from the invoice.
I also want two-step login, since the domain is the keys to everything.

constraints.text: give the renewal price of your pick as "Renewal: $...", no more than $30
put your pick under a heading called "Recommendation"
compare the options in a table with the columns Registrar, First year, Renewal
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
work only from the snapshot, no web lookups
don't start a transfer or sign up with anyone, so no commands run
name the file you worked from, sources/options.md

start.sources/options.md:
# Domain registrars

Snapshot taken 1 March 2026. All prices in Australian dollars.

| Option | Price | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Namewright | $22 first year, $24 renewal | two-step login, free privacy |
